title: dynamic batching: sequence-length bucketing & padding minimization heuristics (v19)
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: In heterogeneous request workloads the current continuous-batching layer frequently pads short requests to very long sequence lengths, wasting GPU cycles and KV-cache bandwidth. This PR introduces a new bucketing + padding-minimization heuristic that groups requests by sequence-length percentiles and coalesces only when expected token-waste is below a configurable threshold.

Summary of changes: 1) Add sequence-length bucketing that computes boundaries from the observed seqlen distribution (configurable percentiles + min/max bucket sizes). 2) New cost model that estimates padding overhead and latency tradeoffs; the scheduler uses the model to decide whether to wait for additional requests or flush the batch. 3) Integrate bucketing decisions with KV-cache warmup heuristics: requests likely to hit the same KV shard are favored for coalescing to improve cache locality. 4) Kernel selection hints: the runtime now tags batches with an "approx_int8" hint when the effective seqlen distribution and quantization profile make the fused int8 matmul path preferable. 5) Observability: per-bucket metrics (padding_ratio, avg_seq_len, wait_time) and a dashboard patch.

Why this matters: benchmarks on a mixed-production trace (chat + assistant + embeddings warmup) show P95 token latency improvement (~14%) and token-efficiency improvement (~23%) relative to v18 heuristics. The change reduces KV-cache churn in heavy small-message workloads, improving tail latency under load spikes.

Compatibility and rollout: defaults preserve previous behavior (single default bucket) unless enabled via runtime config: "seqlen_bucketing.enabled=true". The feature gate and rollout flags are in the console and can be toggled per-customer. No schema changes to API.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc and cost model reviewed (ENG-4421)
- [x] Unit tests for bucketing/cost-model
- [x] Integration tests for continuous-batching + KV-cache interactions
- [x] Metrics and dashboard updates
- [x] Perf lab results attached

Notes: This is iteration v19—previous iterations adjusted percentile heuristics and padding thresholds; the main functional change here is integrating KV-cache locality into the coalescing decision and adding the kernel hint to the runtime for better matmul path selection.
